text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—The "Rose Clan."
Its origins trace back to a single Umamusume descended from French nobility.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
At one time, a Trainer who recognized her immense potential invited her to Japan.
For the everlasting prosperity and happiness of her clan, harboring grand ambitions in her heart, she raced forth.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Our forebear wished for it: to make her own victory the bedrock of eternal prosperity—
to bestow upon our clan a peace as steadfast as an unshakeable 'kingdom.'

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yet, it fell short of establishing a position solid enough to be called a kingdom—
and to her, crestfallen, the Trainer made a solemn vow.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
“One day, an heir to your will shall surely appear.
If so, I too shall raise one who can support them upon that path.”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
'O glorious Rose Clan.
Until the day your kingdom is founded, we shall faithfully stand by your side—'

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —Our wish is but one.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Glory to the Rose Clan.
Like a kingdom flourishing for all eternity, let the name of the Rose endure forever—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (—And now, that long-cherished ambition is entrusted to him and me.)
choice_data_list: Lady Rose, thank you for making the journey.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (—And now, that long-cherished ambition is entrusted to her and me.)
choice_data_list: Lady Rose, thank you for making the journey.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No. As per the instructions, the used dishes go here.
...May I leave the rest to you?
choice_data_list: Yes. Did it suit your palate?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it was exquisite.
The terrine, in particular, was very much to my liking.
choice_data_list: I am honored. In that case, I shall take custody of this and take my leave.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa~ Rose-san and her trainer have such a unique vibe as always...!
Terrine, she said, terrine. Have you ever had that before?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: No clue! Like, the terrine was crazy enough, but packing lunch boxes for the whole weekend too... isn't this support a little too generous~...?!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Hm, Rose? What's the matter? You have an awfully solemn look on your face.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No...
—Ah, Ruler, you mentioned that before as well, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
They say the bond between my trainer and me is somewhat out of the ordinary.
...Is it truly so?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
What's this, has word finally reached the prince's ears?
—Well, it's the truth. Take that bento from earlier, for instance.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The dorm cafeteria isn't open for lunch on weekends.
Normally, we have to procure our own lunch.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Yet almost every week, you receive a bento made by your Trainer.
While sound as a nutritional management method, people don't usually go to such lengths.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ............So that was it.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(I had heard that "managing nutritional needs is part of the job," but...
Perhaps taking those words at face value was rather naive of me.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(—What else? What burdens he carries, and how heavy they are...
Shouldn't I know the exact truth?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(—What else? What burdens she carries, and how heavy they are...
Shouldn't I know the exact truth?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—I see. I have noted the training schedule starting next week.
That concludes the agenda for our meeting.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...By the way, may I look over
those documents you have in hand as well?
choice_data_list: Eh? Yes, I don't mind, but—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(—! How... incredibly meticulous.
The sheer depth of information is on an entirely different level from what was handed to me.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (Progress, physical condition, mental state... The charts are drafted anticipating every fluctuation. All so that proper care may be provided...)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Just how much time did he dedicate to preparing all this...?
Has he truly reserved any time for himself?)
choice_data_list: Lady Rose? ...Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Just how much time did she dedicate to preparing all this...?
Has she truly reserved any time for herself?)
choice_data_list: Lady Rose? ...Is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Tomorrow is a day off.
What are your plans?
choice_data_list: I have a few errands to attend to, so I shall step out.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see.
In that case, allow me to accompany you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I promise I will not get in your way.
...May I ask this of you?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
First is purchasing books, is it?
Hmm, I am rather fond of reading myself.
choice_data_list: If it's novels you're looking for, they appear to be on that shelf over there.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No, my book can wait.
I shall accompany you.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Around here is... specialized sports science literature. Geared toward Umamusume.
choice_data_list: Yes. I'll be purchasing some books on the latest research.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(It appears they purchased quite a few volumes...
Yet every one of them is a book on training?)
choice_data_list: Next, we'll head to the sporting goods store.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
............
What is your goal?
choice_data_list: It's a trial session for a new training machine.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: A machine trial session... Hmm. So it is being held in the venue over there?

text_block_list.name: Trial Event Staff
text_block_list.text: By linking this machine with smart apparel, we can formulate a substantially more effective training regimen.

text_block_list.name: Trial Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
It allows for fine adjustments as well... The resistance can also be altered
by shifting the angle of the backrest. Please, feel free to adjust it to your liking.
choice_data_list: Thank you. I'll give it a try.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(... They are checking it in remarkable detail.
Testing it firsthand... and even increasing the load?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Hmm...? You were testing it out with such enthusiasm, but are you not purchasing that machine?
choice_data_list: Um, our purpose was just to check, not to purchase—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Are they planning to introduce a model tailored for Umamusume to the academy soon?
And so you came all this way to inspect the machine?
choice_data_list: Yes. I wanted the opportunity to experience the real thing firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
What, a study group among the Trainers?
You are heading there now?
choice_data_list: Yes. Please, go on ahead without me, Lady Rose.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...How could this be—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Is there still time before the study group convenes?
Just a moment is fine. ...Please, let me speak with you.
choice_data_list: ……? Understood.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Upon the table, the untouched black tea that had just been served quietly drifted its fragrant aroma. —Before long, Rose Kingdom spoke up.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
—To fulfill the Rose Clan's long-cherished ambition, to take charge of me,
you have spent your days honing yourself since your youth. Am I correct?
choice_data_list: Y-Yes.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Then allow me to ask once more.
...Did your own free will truly exist within that?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Forgive my foolish question. But today, I have finally realized...
just how much... with what extraordinary devotion you have given your all for me.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: If the mission of the Rose dynasty is binding you to such grueling labor—I cannot simply overlook it.
choice_data_list: That can't be—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I implore you.
Ask your own heart once more.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Are you truly certain—that this path is right for you?
